network.fetch.label: Fetch public network resources
network.fetch.notes: Network access must be explicitly granted and scoped by local Elysia.

filesystem.read_project.label: Read user-selected project files
filesystem.read_project.notes: No home directory, vault, logs, memory, or secrets access by default.

filesystem.write_project.label: Write user-selected project files
filesystem.write_project.notes: Requires explicit local approval and rollback planning.

memory.read_scoped.label: Read scoped Elysia memory
memory.read_scoped.notes: Private memory access is denied until a future scoped policy exists.

memory.write_scoped.label: Write scoped Elysia memory
memory.write_scoped.notes: Private memory mutation is denied until a future scoped policy exists.

model.invoke.local.label: Invoke local model through Elysia
model.invoke.local.notes: Model calls must go through governed Elysia interfaces.

tool.run_sandboxed.label: Run declared tool in sandbox
tool.run_sandboxed.notes: Only future isolated sandbox workers may execute code.

shell.run.label: Run shell command
shell.run.notes: Shell execution is blocked by default.

external_api.call.label: Call declared external API
external_api.call.notes: External APIs must be declared, reviewed, and explicitly approved.
